recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not restore the old core terminology-systems row unless Vocab/TSMG reverses the THO source-of-truth model; future BCP47 identifier or OID maintenance belongs in THO/UTG.
issue_request: FHIR-7536 was a Published/Persuasive vocab issue from the DSTU1 cycle requesting documentation of urn:ietf:bcp:47 as the system URI for language on the terminology systems page.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied in svn revision 5681, represented by git commit 4e71ae0b99417ac172351dfbbb786d4a18539171, which added a urn:ietf:bcp:47 row to source/terminologies-systems.html.
additional_context: FHIR-37853 later made HL7 Terminology the authoritative source for external code and identifier system information and required external rows without FHIR-specific usage pages to be removed from the Code Systems page. Commit 736ccce2005fd2c8c2d20dfe8df948e8c9d586d8 applied that decision and removed the old BCP47 row. THO now carries NamingSystem/ietf3066 with urn:ietf:bcp:47 as the preferred URI.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Re-adding the removed row would conflict with the later FHIR-37853 placement decision, and current core source still communicates the URI through the Language binding and language value set sources.

related_jiras.note: Published/Persuasive R5 issue that moved external terminology authority to THO and explains why the old BCP47 row should not be restored in core.
Unresolved UTG/THO ticket about the OID for urn:ietf:bcp:47; it did not create a final core source-edit decision.
